name: Josh
source: Josh and his friends Nick and Paul are blood bound under Continue?'s banner. They are inseparable and typically found wreaking general havoc by reenacting the '80s and '90s arcade beat-em-ups they love so dearly. Josh, while friendly, is terse and often hard to read. Could there be another side to him?
